# AgentVPS

AgentVPS 0.0.3 turns a Linux VPS into a remote computer for an AI agent.
It provides a real Linux desktop, visible Chromium, shell, code, files, MCP and CLI.
The built-in conversational agent loop is planned, not implemented.

Reuse an existing VPS and agent without another hosted personal-agent subscription.
AgentVPS is free and open source. VPS and chosen agent/model provider fees and limits still apply.

Agents connect directly to authenticated Streamable HTTP MCP at /mcp. No local AgentVPS client or Node.js installation is required. The CLI is for VPS administration only.

- [Linux compatibility and complete test report](https://agentvps.ai-infra.org/compatibility/)
- [Agent installation guide](https://agentvps.ai-infra.org/agent-guide.md)
- [中文安装指南](https://agentvps.ai-infra.org/zh/agent-guide.md)
- [Manual installation](https://agentvps.ai-infra.org/#install)
- [Source and complete reference](https://github.com/agentsdance/agentvps)
- [Release 0.0.3](https://github.com/agentsdance/agentvps/releases/tag/v0.0.3)
- [Agent skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/agentsdance/agentvps/main/skills/agentvps/SKILL.md)

All tool paths refer to the VPS. Call workspace_info first.
Never print or commit access tokens. Respect human desktop takeover.
